description: This file defines the 'AccessControl' struct within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems, including functions to set ownership, permissions, and apply access control settings based on a 'NodeId' object.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A struct providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions, including setting ownership, permissions, and applying access control based on NodeId.

methods.name: OwnerShip
methods.description: Sets the ownership of a file specified by 'node' to the user and group specified by 'userName' and 'groupName'. Uses POSIX functions to retrieve user and group IDs and change ownership.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Sets the permissions of a file specified by 'node' to the mode flags provided in 'modeFlags'. Uses POSIX chmod to apply permissions.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a node represented by 'NodeId', based on its rights and group properties.
